info_1.title: THE REFERENCE POINT
info_1.description: The ASD Volo Libero Montegrappa was founded in 1979 by a group of friends and pilots, with the aim of promoting free flight around Borso Del Grappa, an area that over the years has established itself as the undisputed destination for thousands of Italian and foreign pilots. Since the 1970s, with the first hang gliders, and then from the late 1980s with paragliding, Borso del Grappa has seen many pilots born and helped them grow in this sport thanks to the special aerological characteristics of the area, its wide take-offs easily accessible, and the almost total absence of strong winds. Perfect characteristics both for beginners and for more experienced pilots who intend to undertake cross-country flights and competitions.

membership.title: MEMBERSHIP
membership.description:
From January 1st {NEXT_YEAR}, registrations for Club Volo Libero Montegrappa are open.

To register, you need to create an account (free and without obligations) and proceed with payment of the membership fee. Already registered users can log in directly to their account and renew their membership.

flycard.title: FLYCARD
flycard.description: To fly in the Monte Grappa area using the facilities managed by the Tourism Consortium Vivere il Grappa (take-offs and landings), you must have the Flycard, which can be purchased according to the methods and costs indicated on the Consortium's official website: https://flycard.vivereilgrappa.it

news.title: WHAT'S NEW FOR {NEXT_YEAR}
news.description:
Thanks to an exclusive collaboration agreement reserved for members of Club Volo Libero Montegrappa, a promotion is available for purchasing the annual Flycard at a discounted price of 10€. The Flycard is not included in the membership fee.



How it works:

From January 1st to March 1st, upon completing your Club registration, you will receive a promotional code to use for purchasing the Flycard at the promotional price reserved for members.

The code is personal and unique, can be used only once, and is not transferable to third parties. The code will be sent via email upon payment completion and will always remain available in your reserved area on the website.

important.title: ATTENTION!
important.description:
Membership to Club Volo Libero Montegrappa does not automatically grant immediate right to use the promotion. It is therefore recommended to purchase the Flycard several days in advance of the expected date of use.

For purchase conditions and regulations, please refer to the Vivere il Grappa Consortium website https://flycard.vivereilgrappa.it/rules.



⚠️ For foreign pilots without an Italian Tax Code: to request membership to Club Volo Libero Montegrappa and take advantage of the Flycard promotion, it is necessary to send a request via email to info@vololiberomontegrappa.it.

XcMontegrappaPage.intro:
This initiative is organized and promoted by the Club Volo Libero Montegrappa.

It is not a competition, but a personal challenge that recognizes each pilot's commitment and ability to reach cross-country flying goals.

The routes are based in the Monte Grappa flying area, with takeoff and landing within the designated zones.

Each pilot can freely choose when to fly throughout the year, starting from April 1, {year}.

objectives.title: OBJECTIVES
objectives.lead: The XC Montegrappa certificate was created to:
items: Promote and spread free flight practice in paragliding and hang gliding through predefined routes in the Veneto foothills, with takeoff points on Monte Grappa.
Encourage pilots to improve their experience, foster knowledge sharing, and explore nearby flying areas.
Help less experienced pilots approach cross-country flying through progressive route levels.

howItWorks.title: HOW IT WORKS
howItWorks.description:
XC Montegrappa has three difficulty levels (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced), each made up of predefined tasks with waypoints to pass.

Each task has a score that reflects its difficulty. To earn the certificate, you must reach the minimum required score for that level by summing points earned from completed tasks.

This means that, for each level, it is not strictly necessary to complete every task: you only need to reach the minimum score.



Attention! Each task can count only toward one specific certificate level. A single flight track that includes multiple tasks is valid for one of them only. Therefore, different tasks cannot all be completed in one single flight session.

levels.title: CERTIFICATE LEVELS
levels.lead: Certificates are divided into three increasing difficulty levels:

basic.title: BASIC CERTIFICATE
basic.details: Ideal for pilots at their first cross-country experiences.

intermediate.title: INTERMEDIATE CERTIFICATE
intermediate.details: Includes crossing the main valleys around Monte Grappa.

advanced.title: ADVANCED CERTIFICATE
advanced.details: Routes with higher difficulty due to distance, flight time, and crossings through multiple valleys and diverse environmental contexts.

whoCan.question: Who can participate?
whoCan.answer: All Italian and international pilots compliant with current national free-flight regulations and local rules can take part in the XC certificate from Grappa.

howMany.question: How many certificates can I earn?
howMany.answer: There is no distinction or limit by wing category. Each pilot can enroll and complete one or more levels, and can therefore earn all three certificates: basic, intermediate, and advanced.

whenFly.question: When can flights be made?
whenFly.answer: Flights made from October 1st to September 30th of the following year are considered. You can fly on any day of the week, weather permitting.

whenCollect.question: If I reach the required score, when can I collect my certificate?
whenCollect.answer: In October, during the Volo Libero Montegrappa social dinner, certificates are awarded to pilots who achieved the XC certificate from Grappa.

prizes.question: Are there prizes?
prizes.answer: The XC certificate from Grappa is not a competitive event and has no ranking for specific prizes. However, during the social dinner, prizes are drawn among all pilots who achieved the certificate at any level. Special recognitions are granted to pilots who complete multiple certificates in the same season. Drawn prizes are awarded only to pilots present.
